text: I have been playing Lords Mobile for several years, and during this time I have seen the game evolve through many updates, events, and changes. As a veteran player, I can confidently say that Lords Mobile remains one of the most engaging and strategic mobile games available. The game offers a perfect mix of kingdom building, hero development, research, troop training, and large-scale battles. One of the most exciting aspects is the guild system. Working together with guild members, participatin

I played this game few years ago and recently came back to try it again. Lords Mobile still has a strong core—strategy, guild teamwork, and events can be engaging, especially in the early stages. The social aspect used to be one of the best parts, and it’s still possible to meet people and enjoy the game casually. However, the game has become heavily pay-to-win over time. The number of systems (artifacts, astralite, skins, etc.) makes it very difficult for new or returning players to catch up.

Overall the game is not that bad. There is so much to do that it will take you a long time to truly become bored with the game. My 2 biggest gripes of this game is that 1. Unless you pay, it takes forever to get to a decent level to be able to do anything, otherwise you are crushed all of the time. 2. Unless you are on the game almost all of the time and keep your shields up, you loose just about everything that is not in your 'bags.' So as you work things up and start to collect anything, unless you use it or keep shielded 24 hours a day 7 days a week, someone from a larger guild comes and takes it. That is why I give 1 star. I tried to get on as much as I could and the one time I was busy and did was not able to login to reapply my shield at the time of expiration and I am attacked and lost hundreds of millions of resources that took me months to work up in a few minutes because someone was lucky enough to be there at the right time. I know, the point of the game, but highly annoying, especially with the time I spent putting into this game. Not playing this game to restock someone who was lucky enough to be around to attack me 50 times to get everything. piss off.

Pretty good overall. I don't really like the PvP aspect of it (personal preference, nothing mechanical was wrong), in fact, that's why I uninstalled. I was attacked repeatedly by several members of the same guild, despite having never attacked anyone, let alone them. As you can imagine, much of my time on here was spent just grinding for resources. But, the other chunk of time was spent upgrading heros and expanding my turf, which I loved. My biggest complaint about the game itself is that it forces the player to be part of a guild if they ever want to experience the whole game, rather than the half that you start with. Also, the member requirement for starting a new guild is a bit high for my liking. Now, my biggest compliment is on just how much detail you guys put into this! I can tell that you really care about this game and the players' experiences. I was blown away by all the stat sheets and the backstories.

As every game has it, there are in-app purchases for a faster experience, but it's a really good game, especially being partnered with other services as well. Would give it 8 stars if I could. (Only because, me personally, the amount of buttons and areas on the screen was a but overwhelming and sensory overload at first.) However, it's easy to navigate with help.

I played up to level 25 and decided the game was just too predatory to continue to play. I understand the concept of mobile games in general (squeeze as much money out of players as possible) but I have never played one like Lord's where you could spend real life money and have it all taken away/destroyed by someone who spent more real life money than you did. It's strictly pay to win. If you go in knowing that, it can be a fun little time waster...but there are MUCH better options out there.

This is a pure pay to win game. While it is free to play - you will NOT get far - and being a pvp game, you will always be a victim if you do not pay a LOT of money.  Now, substance-wise .. the game does not shine much. There is not much. There are party based hunts that are luck based with occasional timed skill clicks, there is resource gathering which is just a time spender and a few events that are on the more simplistic side.   All in all, the complexity and "skill" of this game does not exceed the mental demand of a cookie clicker by any significant margin.   Balance-wise .. i found it to be a nightmare.... and even if you only look at the social component (chatting) it is a minimalist.   The presentation/visuals are nice, animations are OK-ish and character design is actually cute.   If this game offered tactical depths, better balanced large scale battles (like when a 200k army attacks a 100k army .. i would still expect more than 150 dead on the 200k army vs. the 100.000 dead on the smaller one) and made those party style hunting stages actually FUN (as in control the characters like a real RTS) - it would be a VERY good game.  As it is .. rather mehh

After anesthesia (back surgery)I purchased a $99 pack and refunded it when I fully came to. They demanded I repay the $99 or my account would be blocked from the store. Tried explaining, wouldn't budge. I felt like I was being blackmailed so I refunded everything that I could. Now I'm being banned in 3 days if I don't pay back the $99 plus the other small purchases. I actually really enjoyed the game, and the people that I met. This left a really bad taste in my mouth.

Truely enjoyable. My only issue is that there is no help menu to assist with figuring out how to navigate through certain tasks that can be unclear. Other than that, it's a really satisfying game to play. I enjoy building my empire and defending it. I wish there were options to buy the items to upgrade heroes ranks more quickly. It's a fun game and can sweep you away with all the activity needed to run the empire smoothly.

Massive p2p game. The last update has shown that you need loads of cash to progress. On top of that, the kingdoms are full of bots, making this an awful experience for shielded players who would like to gather resources. If I knew how it would end up, I would have never started this game. It is finally time to quit after 2 years of daily login.

Do you like waiting hours on end for a seemingly pointless payout and being constantly asked if you want to buy things to "help" you? There are self imposed wait times for literally everything. Addicted, hard to wait this resist spending money, upper tier level ups take weeks then months. You need about five accounts, One Main and four resource accounts. Fun game! Have been playing actively each day the past few months. The most recent auto-use feature for the speed-ups mechanic is helpful, but could be better. I wish it would calculate the time remaining up to the "Free" use, but not going over. This would allow me to then wait the remaining few minutes or use gems instead of losing speedups minutes.

This is not a game: it's a part-time job.  But before I rant about the grind-fest that is this income-less side gig, let's talk about the meaning of words. The construction "queue" can only ever have one task in it. That's not a "queue". That's just "a task". An actual queue would be awesome, and super-easy to implement (I'm a software engineer... if it isn't easy, fire your development team and start over). A research item or upgrade that would allow simultaneous construction would be another option. Either would be great.  But the "single task at a time" means that at or around castle level 9, you stop actually playing the game and start waiting on it. And waiting. And waiting. And waiting. And waiting. Twice a day you can slop out some hero levels, assuming you haven't maxed out what handful of heroes you've scrounged. The leader level is a limiting factor on hero levels, and you have to wait on quests (including construction) to complete for that to go up. Despite being a "strategy" war-sim, battles give the LEAST leader experience. And then there's more limiting factors on battles with "energy" and other garbage.  I got bored at castle level 10. I stopped playing.

Today tried it again with a small item of 1,09 euro. But still the same problem.....  3 times in a row that I can't buy items. I think this game is losing it's quality.

Game is way too hard to new players to get into, much more powerful players will attack the hell out of you non stop. Game is pay to win. I have made it to lvl24 castle without spending money. But have finally decided to throw in the towel due to unfair game structure. Being in a guild doesn't always mean your safe. I have seen players with more might than a guild. Your guild will not protect you from someone like that. It is a fun game but impossible for new players to get a foothold in.

Its boring unless you spend a bunch of money!! All you do is build and fight, there's no strategy usage or customization. It's pretty boring. I mean its great..... for the game creators and company. They profit so much. You dont even have control of the armies. It's not a good game I dont recommend this game unless you're willing to spend a lot of REAL MONEY or spend 35 years getting a big army.

Pretty cool game, has some more unique features compared to some of the other games in its genre, I don't like that you cannot begin constructing ANYTHING ELSE or even train your men until the previous item finished, it would be nice if there was some separation. Maybe have the training separated so that way at least those can train while still waiting for other things to finish.and more free speed ups, cause yalls gems are too $, if your broke don't bother playing this one!

This game is really cool and additive to play. It's got great graphics, multiple tasks to complete and many different changes to conquer. Lots of battles and monster hunting. Its easy to obtain the resources needed to build your empire, research new technology and train your soldiers. In app purchases are fair and there's always a promotional sale on them as well. It's not necessary to purchase anything in game in order to grow and achieve any of the task in game. The only flaw I find is it takes a long time to level up soldiers and VIP. But it's easy to obtain the many different hero's in the game. Some things are unclear as to how to use them. There's international player media and teamwork amongst many of the guild in game. All in all game has real challenge to it and it's fun to play.

This game is quite good, I love the graphics, they are clean, detailed, and good looking, the game is fun and can be quite addictive, there's alot of things to do, it isn't just focused on a single aspect, though it could use more useful rewards (Speed Ups and gems), cause when you begin to Maxout upgrades they take crazy long time 😔, which can be annoying. In general it's great game 👍.

Super pay to win. Late-game upgrades take months without speed-ups and there are too many over-powered wallet warriors ready to zero you as soon as your shield goes down. The game takes too long to start to be able to defend, especially with travel speed-ups. Edit: Now the game randomly signs me out. When you join as a new account, it forces you through the tutorial. This wouldn't be a big deal if it didn't only seem to happen when I'm getting attacked. We need a sign in as existing user button.

One of the latest features, the "auto use" of resources and speedups is a tremendous improvement. It makes a huge difference when doing research, training,... The only improvement to it would be a setting to indicate whether it is allowed to exceed the necessary amount of time or not. E.g.: when merging would take 8h1min, the "auto use" will use 1 8h and 1 15min speedup. If you don't want to exceed the amount of time, you have to do it manually.

Lords Mobile was once a true war game where strategy and teamwork mattered. Free players could fight, defend, and win through skill. Now it’s a wallet war. No matter your billions of might, a P2P whale can zero you in minutes. Heroes, gear, and troops are locked behind paywalls. The battlefield that rewarded brains now rewards spending. What was once war is now just a marketplace disguised as battle.

I got into it because I liked the combat that the ads showed. Then I learned it would take half a year to unlock that combat. THEN I learned that the combat in the ads isn't even accurate. This isn't a strategy game at all, just a competition of who has more troops and more money to throw at the game. Not happy with how it's portrayed. If you want to advertise it, at least be honest. A decent game all in all, otherwise, but still overwhelmingly pay to win. Please stop lying in your ads

The game is fun once your in a good guild, that said the new feature "auto use" helps speed up the process quite a bit. That said there are a few problems like how long certain upgrades take in the longer game (some even take up year if you dont have the proper boosts), the other one is no black list feature in a guild a problem that ive been dealing with as of late, unless you set the guild to private mode there is no way to stop a person thats been kicked from the guild to re join.

The game overall is amazing and addictive! I absolutely love it...my issue is that you have to pay a lot to be able to get to the biggest level. Also, you charge nearly £20 in the UK for packs that in China or other countries, cost much much less, so those people and guilds get more for their money, meaning they can build better and faster. It's kinda irritating and has made me consider how much longer i will be playing...

False advertisement... the actual game is nothing like the ads they aggressively show everywhere. I'm sure many will find this fun, but man it's so misleading. I'm surprised no one has filed a class action. I've been playing for a month now or so thinking I just need to unlock these cool features, not high enough level, or maybe it's an ingame purchase of some kind... nope!

this game has a lot of potential , but it's anoying the amount of advertisements for it,and the worst part is that 99% of them are fake,and that is really a shame because it is actually a good game! you can build your kingdom in any way you want,you can attack your neighbors,you can build a guild with your friends and a lot more,but the way its advertised makes it look unoriginal and overall flat. the graphics are stylish,the gameplay is ok and the plot is actually good! but the ads kills it.

Its a good game. I enjoyed it for a time, but the constant attacks from other high level players are very annoying. You always have to have a shield up, but once it runs out you're attacked and your resources are gone. There should be a certain time that all players can attack each other that way lower lvl players have a chance to save themselves. Edit. 3/9/2020. Did all that but it doesnt matter. I deleted the game. Never gonna reinstall

I was pleasantly surprised with the way the game was put together. It's a refreshing take on the MMO Strategy game genre incorporating more facets, has a completely different feel and much more playability. Unfortunately I cannot give it five stars due to the lack of shield stacking. A casual player will find themselves with expired sheilds, city ransacked time and time again halting forward progress. If that changes some day maybe I will play again. Money spenders dominate this game as well.

The ad I saw dealt with getting more troops than the enemy's by selecting one of two math choices to modify your troops. That's not the game. I'm not playing it anymore, because the gameplay doesn't match the ad I saw. As for the actual game, it's different from the usual defense games I've seen where the focus is more on attacking instead of defending. It's a give orders type game. Edit: "Creative liberty" means the misleading ad is intentional. All the more reason to not play.

I've been playing for a little over 2 years. Haven't missed a consecutive login since I started. Certainly takes a long time to progress unless you're willing to spend entire paychecks-worth of goodies. Regardless, the recent Auto-Use feature has been probably the greatest feature introduced since I started playing. Saves time, but more importantly I'm not wasting a massive amount of food racing back at the mercy of the game and device processor. Thanks for making it free.

Look for better options for your strategy gaming.  This one has big stability problems.  I played for a few weeks, and the game crashed multiple times.  In one instance, I paid money and used the in game 'speedups" to complete a one hour event that offered rewards.  I was almost finished with the requirements of the event, having used the resources I bought, and then the game crashed.  Time expired while the game was down, and I couldn't complete the event to get the rewards.  But IGG would not make the situation right.  IGG is a horrible company, and the game isn't worth playing if it is going to crash so frequently.

It's a pretty darn fun game. Fun, interactive, and easy to grasp the flow of the game. I gave it 4 stars because I wish some of the heroes were easier to unlock in-game without buying tokens (which costs $). It's possible but takes forever. And also because the guilds thing can get annoying when they clump up and attack your castle over and over, forcing constant repairs. But as far as apps go, this one really is a fun one.

I never expected to get so caught up in the game to the point that I have two accounts. The new features are very helpful. The Santuary has saved me many a soldiers. And the Auto Use feature makes things quicker even though some times I end up using a speed up greater than the time remaining. My only feedback would be to allow me to select which speed ups I use. For example, I can use regular and training speed ups for training but I would only want to use the training ones and save the others.

Grabage Checklist: 1. Clicking, and that is all 2. Waiting for extreme amounts of time to upgrade something, only to recieve minimal rewards 3. Grinding, did I mention that? 4. A game that almost forces you to spend real world money, only to find that again, the effort/rewards do not make the game more enjoyable. 5. Copy/Paste art and level design. 6. Extremely expensive skins starting at $24. I'm sure the list could go on and on. But seriously, the only minigame in this isnt even interactable.

Riddled with glitches and extremely frustrating. I was drawn in by the variety of game play and cool features, as compared to other similar games, so I played a lot and even spent a good amount of money. But the Colosseum cheats for the defense, among many other issues that end up wasting a lot of costly items and speed ups, which cost money. I got completely destroyed a few times when the game logged me out for days after an update, or froze up during battle, leaving me defenseless. At one point I couldn't get the game to work at all for weeks, even tried several different devices. I kept playing because I invested so much time and money, but eventually I couldn't take it anymore.... Try a different game, or none like this at all.

Very addictive since they try to rope you in with quick rewards and task completion at first, also the graphics are fairly good. However, at a certain point the game becomes repetitive, you have to wait too long to earn might (points), and it becomes a pay to win game. Furthermore, the content stops once you get to certain point of progress in the game, and they have not been doing much to add content besides creating events that give you rewards to keep you playing their boring game.

There's way too much going on. As soon as you try to get used to something, you level up and more and more things unlock. It's hard to navigate between the copious amounts of events and verges, hero battles, adventures, etc. Too many tabs and buttons. I don't even know all of my troops well or what the objective is even supposed to be. I just wish the game was more user-friendly for beginners and has fewer activities.

It's a literal time-suck. All you do is set timers. You set timers to build, quest, research, etc., and then you have to wait... and wait... and wait, to start the next timer/action. I played this game to get bonus stuff for another game, but I was excited by the prospect of finding another fun distraction... I did not. I had to level the Castle up to lv12 for my bonus stuff, and it took 27hrs just to upgrade the Castle from a lv11 to lv12! And you have to level everything else up first, before you can level up the Castle... over and over again, one at a time. I don't know where they got the graphics they are showing for this game, but they look nothing like the actual game. This is a complete waste of time, and you don't control anything accept the starting of the suggested timers. The only good things I can say about this game is that I got my bonus stuff, and it's over!

I am sick and tired of people raiding me. it's obvious this game is pay to win, because I watch the battle, they breach my walls instantly, and I lose 50,000 to their 300. I want a permanent shield. there is clearly nothing stopping someone who's played for months, and thrown money at this game, raiding someone who's played for 5 days and spent less.

Good game so far, classic kingdom builder. Just started, I'll say more when I know more. After further review, I am giving you one star review because the commercials that I see on YouTube and on the game itself, are 100% misleading and show nothing about the gameplay. The ads are false advertising and the game is nothing like what they want you to believe. How the game is played and all the mechanics are completely different.

Very addictive game. Starts as a "free to play" but if you want to compete, you end up buying a lot of "in game tools". Makes this game be way more expensive than a game that you pay upfront for. Many players end up pay way more than 100usd per months. You've been WARNED. edit: I rated 3 stars initially, but will withdraw one more star as I regularly struggle having online data on my cellphone wherever the game requires me to! :( DON'T install if you have unreliable data! (3G/4G networks)

Lords Mobile is a fun and deep strategy game that’s perfect for fans of real-time strategy and RPGs. There’s a lot of content to dive into, and the social and competitive aspects really keep things engaging. But the pay-to-win mechanics and the time investment needed can be off-putting for some players. Rating: 5/5 - Great game, but be prepared to either spend money or dedicate a lot of time to progress effectively.

Lords Mobile is a strategy game that combines kingdom building, hero collection, and real-time battles. The game looks great and has a lot of content to explore, especially if you join an active guild. Planning your attacks, defending your turf, and choosing the right hero lineup are the most interesting parts. However, progress can be slow unless you invest time (and sometimes money), and the game does lean toward a pay-to-win system. Overall, it’s fun and engaging if you enjoy strategic game

This game was fun. Definitely a cash grab game. You will need additional resources & gems, you will get tired of constantly waiting. It takes way to long to get guild coins in a small guild! Shields are way to expensive! After playing for a couple of months and start getting confident, they open your land up for older, larger guilds/people (most 10 levels higher than you) to move in, then you are screwed. I've been attacked and destroyed at least 10 times in the last three days. Not fun any more  *Update: Not a helpful reply IGG. I already know that I need shields. Shields are expensive and cost gems, which cost real money. Maybe if you would give out more gems per dollar, I'd still be playing it. unfortunately it is to late for that. I have had it with this game, it has been officially uninstalled from the phone. I've already spent more money on this game than I ever care to admit.

Addicting game. I probably spent over $300 in this game unfortunately. It is free to play but it is not free to play friendly. Needed items in the game are rare and difficult to achieve unless you pay for them. The Cargo Ship says there's always new items to trade but it's always only resources or speed ups. Wouldn't recommend if you don't want to spend money

Don't know why I had a 5 star review for this set, you literally have to pay hundreds of dollars to complete paid(the best) heroes, and thousands to be truly competitive without some other whale jumping from server 1 to crush you. They'll offer $30 'deals' for heroes, but it'll only get you 1 star, don't even bother. I only had fun for thw challenge of beating on low-tier whales, and that was weeks of preparation. It's just not worth your time.

I started this game from a casino game ad and decided to download and wouldn't you know it, I was hooked. They've come up with some really good features like, sanctuary and the ever so great Auto Use button that uses speedups and RSS without you have to guess at the amounts needed. Guys keep up the great work with the game and can't wait to see what the future holds instore for it. I just started another account, let's see how it turns out.

this game suck now I played this game years before and now I can't even logon properly in my old facebook account without playing an irritating intro which no one asked for.Evwrything sucks here I cant even find a way to switch account to my old one and I have to play the irritating intro on top of that.This sucks.This game used to be a good one.
truly bored- tutorial takes too long to get through, cant access sound settings for at least 20 to 30 minutes of gameplay. gameplay is just kind of lackluster. Didnt have fun

I starte to play the game to make a guild with a friend and play together, but the more we played, the more we found out about the bad sides of the game, and especially devs. The devs don't do anything with the feedback, make maps too small for the amount of players, and leave crucial information out. Constantly. Not only was our guild disbanded with no warning, the only way to know of why was to browse the community made wiki. So we stopped playing, even though we had spent money on the game.

I like the build aspect of this game. The fights to gain territory are challenging. Finishing all of them with first level troops is challenging but doable. This is my 6th game I currently have going so I already know what to do. It makes research projects a breeze. Because I already know what order to do them in. Joining a guild first thing is very important. An active group will greatly increase your build speed.

This is largely a pretty fun game. HUGE disparity between the highest and lowest might which the developers have yet to address... In fact the last few updates made the gap grow larger. New players aren't protected for very long and eventually have to spend money for shields so is probably less fun for new players. The "Auto-use" feature helps you quickly use resources but under certain circumstances can be triggered without need. Food gets wasted then if negative, forcing you to use even more.

Been playing over a year now, and still not bored! This game has a terrific end game and replay value, allowing people to experiment with different build paths. However, don't be fooled by the fast-paced early game, this game requires steady dedication and carefully planned tactics. Equipment is difficult to come by (and potentially pricey), but with a little inginuity, even a totally F2P person can withstand the brunt of a top tier attack! Looking at some of the 3 star reviews here, this game is perhaps one of the better modern examples of why size doesn't mean everything, and planning can be stronger than power! Are you ready for the challenge?

This is a really nice enjoyable game, with lots of variety of activity, nice graphics and game play. Why 3 stars then... because having played it for 3 months it is impossible to play without paying and then the enjoyment goes. Found I was left behind by my guild in might and development and there are so many op'd guys it becomes impossible to play and compete. Tile hitting is rife and I keep getting long term shield glitches, with them failing after a few hours, leaving u open to get zero'd.

After playing so many strategy games. I feel as though this game has a simplistic texture that allows players to feel their way through the game and not dissolve their interest. If someone where to come from another game, something more airy and distant, making them feel as though they were not really playing a game, they would have reason and forthwith to continue towards the higher levels and prestige of Lord's Mobile. (compared to another strategy games...)

I saw an ad for this game and thought it looked cool. Downloaded it. It autoran once completed, in the middle of another application i might add, and looked nothing like the game that was advertised. I played it for a bit to make sure and, no, totally different structure, perspective, gameplay, the ony thing that was the same was it's fantasy theme and art style. It deserves maybe two stars but my experience began feeling betrayed by the ad campaign so I'm giving it one.
really enjoying the strategy and building aspects. the hero system is really cool. I wish they had more beginner packs. maybe the game will offer them later.

Recommending don't start. It's true, there are many fun aspects of this game, including many minigames, however, it does require daily logins and is time intensive. It's colourful and fun gameplay, but if you are a free to play (f2p) player, save yourself some time and don't start. Your only purpose will be as cannon fodder for those spending money. The best heroes and gear are only possible to own with cash, and lots of it. Three heroes are referred to as the 11K heroes since they would each cost $11,000 USD to purchase. Add the cost of gear, and money to quickly upgrade troops and buildings, and with the value of some big accounts, you could buy a house. It's ridiculous, so it makes it impossible for the average person to compete end game. Very frustrating. Unless you have the money to burn and a lot of time, don't start.

I like this game alot. It's just that I'm free to play and getting some of the materials from monsters has a really low drop rate. I was wondering if this drop rate could increase as the game would be more fun. You spend hours trying to get 1 item from the monster and u end up getting nothing because it's a 0.2% drop rate. At least increase this for free to play users.

Both the ad and the playable ad were nothing like the actual game, I'm pretty sure all the people who put 5 stars were paid or helped produce the game. It's probably the sneakiest game I have ever seen. As I saw the ad, I thought it was probably fake but cool,so I tried the playable ad. Nothing like the ad shown, then I got into the real game, and it made me feel like I had witnessed time travel and ended up with the cavemen because how much it had down-graded was crazy. I don't recommend.

F2P if you have nothing but time, found a great guild, met some good people, not at all what is advertised as a tower defense type game. Be prepared to spend a lot of money or wait a long time (6months to 1 year) to properly compete . Mutilple mini games to accommodate differing addictions. The game in the ad looks like fun, this game is not that.

Played the game for over a year and half, very much enjoyed it. Had to let it go due to the stress of always having to set alarms and shield up. Combing that with real life schedule, just became tiring after awhile. If you miss your shield once or twice, your zeroed out. Takes forever to heal up, save up or unless you spend big bucks, keep up. I was an average 5-10$ monthly or every other month and it barely made a dent. Was fun but customized for gamers that have a lot of $$$ and time.

Pay to win garbage. Some of the better heroes are cash shop only, and to max just one of them will cost you around $275. You can buy an actual gaming console and a game for the price of ONE maxed hero in this game. On top of that, the gameplay is trash. You spend your time looking at timers 90% of the time. People that pay will be years ahead of free players. This is a game for whales, and there's barely any gameplay to it. The hero combat has a small promise of being engaging, but in PvP it's all automated and you just watch. Army vs Army is mostly a game of numbers and rock paper scissors. If you pay serious money to play this game, you have trash tastes and probably an addiction problem.

This game is horrible. Can barely progress. It's all pay to win. Should be a Might limit when attacking others. Shields cost gem that's hard to come by if your not putting real money in, I can work for months to get an okay troop count just to have some one bigger than me attack me the very second my shield falls. The trove take forever and requires too much the even be used. The research take YEARS to do. I have had this game for years and have gotten stuck because of no might attack limit.

False Advertising. This is not an action game. It's one of those click and wait games where you have to let real time pass before you can do stuff, and the actual gameplay it isn't anything like the commercials where you select your defenses and destroy waves of enemies. The fights happen without you doing anything. Worst of all, you MUST be connected to WiFi or a mobile network to play.

It's a ok game. It's has lots of bots and if you want to spend lots of money to have a chance of surviving. It takes long time to upgrade your castles without speed ups. Once you save up resources, the people who spend money to make themselves strong attack you and try to force you to spend money. A lvl 25 Castle can attack lower lvl bases so you don't have a chance. The makers want this to happen. There are people using a program to make themselves stronger. One Castle went from lvl 3 to 25.

Things to expect if you install: you'll spend 90% of the time shielded in a bubble. Every month they do a new collab, but it's always the same puzzle mechanics that require spending hundreds of real-world money to complete. The game is full of bots that can track your location, tell when your shield is down, etc, giving some guilds a huge advantage which ruins the experience. Getting decent gear takes years if you're completely F2P. Overall, I wouldn't recommend.

Lords mobile is my favorite game. It's a real time, tower defense, strategy game. But its unlike any game I've played in these categories before, it stands out with its unique gameplay and extras that add to the fun of the game. Attacking, and the "campaign" levels are by no way point and click at random. Sure, you can take this approach but you'll lose every attack, and get stuck on the 2nd chapter for the campaign. So any review claiming this obviously didn't play long.

If you like building, it is ok. Designed for people to pay to grow fast. Also notifications are very inconsistent, on android at least. Complained for a year and the only real solution is to turn off and on and to be in game frequently. Ex. I was on the phone in another app, no notifications of attacks and was in game a moment before. If you are impatient and not in this game a lot, NOT the game for you.

I've played for 5 years now , After artifact updated the game just became pay for stat. Early on, i in love with the game for it development such as defuff update , familiar updated and many good thing we can develop in time. For heroes, Look Watcher and chaos dragon for example , max those took dedication for it self not just pay to max. The game lose it touch for in battle it self, it disapointment for me too. Back then it was learning experience for update, GAP is to much. Happy Spending Guys

I like playing this game for the most part and it is pretty easy to play it reminds me a lot of clash of clans, what I dont like is how long it takes when you get up to the higher castle levels it takes days and if you are not pay to play when some attacks you it takes over to weeks for you to heal your defenses, I feel this game is a little unfair to those looking to have fun but dont really want to spend a ton of money on the game

The game is pretty fun but it's plagued by issues. It's just like every free to play game out right now in that they flood you with goodies in the beginning and get you hooked on the fast pace improvement. After awhile it all slowly begins to dwindle until you need to spend money to keep up with the pace. On top of this, the achievements I was supposed to get for Gamekit never transferred over. To be short, it's fast and fun at first, the it slows down and asks you for your wallet.

What can I say? It's an awesome game. Rich in content and stuff to do. People crying about being zeroed xD come on it's a game of war! That's the whole point. Grow, join a decent guild and keep building and train troops and do the research! Shield and Shelter! It's super easy and such an awesome community! I had an issue once and got it sorted in 2 DAYS! That's quick! So yeah I think you guys are doing awesome!

Love the game and I am always happy when we are given free gems for maintenance time. It's nice. The problem that exists is my shield will be over and it's nighttime, bedtime so when I wake up I will be under attack if the game is back on and lose a lot of what I gained. I am sure the people who own the game are trying but hope they understand the players frustrating end too.

Lords is a decent game so far and offers another *version* through the Samsung Mobile Game Hub (Game Booster stuff). I just wish that the one for the Game Hub offered achievements but that's more about Hub problems not Playstore.

Game is nice but strictly for p2w users. For f2p users, if u expecting to build your equipment by free... Just forget it and find sth else to play, the material needed to build the necessary monster gear have literally 0 drop rate!!! In every gear piece, there is one of the materials that you won't be able to collect, no matter the lvl or how many monsters you gonna kill...!!!

Don't waste your time on this game. This game rewards the higher tier gamers to attack your castle from any level, there is no control. You can build an army of 100,000 soldiers all your hard earned money can will be lost in matters of seconds by any other player who has millions of soldiers. At level 17 any higher player will be rewarded just for capturing your hero. Player attack your castle for any thing they can take. I am level 2, very stressed and I am quitting this game.

I've been playing for 2yrs and at first I really love it and i invested a lot of time, money,effort and emotion in the process but as time pass by you'll just realize how unfair the game is if you don't use money and most guilds are becoming inactive ... Some players are friendly but sometimes they argue too much and says bad things to each other...

Game pretends to be free to play, but in reality it's practically impossible to do so. The construction time is measured in days and months, research tree is measured in years at the top end... to complete all research would require centuries without speed ups or top tier gear. Top tier of all items in game requires cash spending. Its pretty much just a credit card battle sim.

Very addicting and very fun. Good strategy game. With the added benefit of playing with others all over the world, it makes the game more enjoyable. What SUCKS is the notifications aren't what they used to be. Before notifications were instant. Now they're pretty delayed. By the time you get them and start to react, your troops would already be dead.

Lords Mobile is a better, stylized version of what has become the standard castle builder game. Like in all of these games there's a lot going on, but this one doesn't feel as overwhelming as some others. The game screen may seem crowded to first-time players, but it's easy to navigate, and the tutorial is measured enough not to cause too much confusion. I really enjoy the overall design and animation. The characters are fun and interesting if not necessarily unique. So far I find the game fun.$

So for I'm been play for a few months now, my experience as been great so far, mainly because I join guild that treat each other good, but !!!! The issue I find with this game is like any other MMORPG with pvp, high level monster, I meant players attacker alot . But by preparing daily to avoid the enemy it's good, I like the new auto use system made thing easy to add needed reason to do stuff like training, constructing ... I really like this game so far. I think anyone else would get addicted

Totally addicting. My wife has been playing this for years it seems. I never understood why until I really gave it some time. I'm patient but if you aren't be ready to be tempted to buy your way to speeding things up. I'll never catch up to my wife but at least now I know what she's talking about. We can both exchange stories and experiences in the game. Overall pretty fun. Does require maintenance of your account. Logging on everyday will be helpful.

This game caters to the money spenders, its somewhat - difficult at the start, but i highly recommend join a guild. The game it self is pretty okay, but i still find this game frastrating especially when it has to do with monster hunting. Level 1s, easy 1-hit-kill; Level 2s , takes 3 or 4 hits; Level 3s 9 or 10hits; Level 4 you can't solo it unless you use additional energy and/or the sabertooth's ultimate skill, and the same goes with Level 5s. The game is roughly over 4 years, like please Fix!

All I'm asking is maybe add a feature where we could upload our real photo (picture of our self) as our profile in the game, because I'm so sick at looking the same character every single time I visit a player's profile, that's why this idea might be good for someone else because they might like seeing their favourite friend (in the game) uploads their picture/s. Thanks again Lord Mobile Team. 😁😀🙂

SUGGESTED. But it only takes one day to rebuild your castle walls and a day or two to rebuild your army no matter what levels Castle you are. Then players will want to fight other players of the same level rather than bullying other players all the time. CONCLUSION. DON'T PLAY THIS GAME UNLESS THEY MAKE SOME TIME IMPROVEMENTS OR YOU'RE WASTING YOUR TIME AND MONEY. IT BECOMES VERY BORING AND REPETITIVE EVEN IF YOU MAKE ANOTHER ACCOUNT IT'S THE SAME.

First of all I really like the game. There's a few things that I dislike though first of all it takes too long to get all your Castle attributes up to a level 25. Also there's way too much research to get to other levels. I have already spent over a hundred bucks on this game and I have research that takes up to 18 days I've been trying to get tier 4 troops stopping for a month now. And with all the research I have to do it probably will be another month to two months before I get them.

love the game! There's just so much to do. the graphics are pretty good all the short mini games are fun. Build a strong army with your allies. Plenty of ways to keep the game going. So no need to wait hours. Also plenty of packages to buy that fit your needs, while not breaking your pockets. If you enjoy strategizing. Then I recommend trying it!

I have to update my ratings after this recent update. For 3 years I become one of your advocates convincing my friends to play this game and lucky to be part of an awesome guild. But today you changed how I view the game. Lords Mobile is the best strategy/ war game that I have played so far and it has it's own unique game play that we all enjoy. You were able to build a solid branding that separates you from other games out there. Now it becomes an ordinary and the same as those farming games!

Love the game. The new "Auto Use" Feature definitely is a time saver when it comes to using the best possible configuration to conserve resources. Another new and useful feature is the auto open and auto delete function in order to open all guild gifts and delete all with the click of 1 button. I remeber when this was not a current feature and it was very time consuming when opening 300 gifts a day. Well Done IGG!

The game is fun and enjoyable even though I am a free to play, I manage to stand toe by toe to strong foes. However, there is one thing that made me rate this only 3 stars and that is there are a lot of chinese players who tend to harrass weaker players which makes the game experiece a bit crappy. I suggest adding a limit on how many times you can attack a player in a day just to give weaker players a chance to get stronger and to enjoy the game fully.

I'm sorry but why does everything new have to cost money! Not everyone can afford to pay £20 for a castle skin and £5 for friggin emojis!! I was enjoying this game but it's really starting to annoy me that everything is becoming money money money. Hero's fair enough but you get alot of money through the packs can't you make skins and emojis unlockable by a new research tree or something :( Also, why don't the monsters ever drop "rare" items? Do i need to boost my monster research and hit higher level monster or do they just not ever drop those materials?

Fun to a point. You get to a point where the game is almost impossible to progress without time items that you wind up needing to pay for. The fact that there are castles with over 2 billion might is insane to allow someone like that in a kingdom with significantly lower abilities. You literally have to be on the game all the time to avoid getting burned. The recovery process is long and annoying. The game is a massive time suck. If you aren't working and have money to burn, this game is for you

Frustrated,look, the game is fun, good graphics and everything but i don't know if this is a cellphone or game malfunction, the thing is I leave my troops gathering resources, then i go to do another things with my notifications in on as marked as primordial/see first/ important but then i go to the game again and my infirmary is full because apparently i got attacked but i didn't receive any notification for that matter, or i got the notifications like 10 min laters, that's dogshit

I really like the auto use feature they have added, although I do think they should only take what rss is required for building or research, instead of taking over the amount if it isn't needed for the task. If we've already placed it in storage, we have to do this all over again, which causes us to use more rss to trade to re-store that rss. I do think there should be more than one way to save our game.
not a bad game. lots to do. good options. fun waist of time
been having a lot of fun playing this game having fun with the voyages and I haven't had a problem with the program lagging or kicking me out

Although I've had a rough time starting out and have now uninstalled this game, I'm glad that I was in a Guild that was structured well and wasn't too demanding of me. I think this game could use some improvements for weaker players, but when you're in a Guild, it makes the experience better. Especially with nice and laid back members. Overall, the game was nice, but I uninstalled it for having a horrific time with it in September 2018.

The game itself is actually pretty interesting, but what could've been more better. Is if yous made it so we can put our troops on the map ourselves like clash of clans. And make it so we can see what other people's fortresses look like etc. And made it a lot easier to unlock characters nd monsters. Do that and I'll give it a 5 star thank you for your cooperation.

Extremely pay to play heavy. Very hard for people who have no interest in dropping money into it to advance. Edit: I returned to the game and found that it did have some major improvements that can assist free to play players. However, these improvements also assist pay to play players so the gap is exactly the same. The game is riddled with players selling cheap resources which even further increases the gap between f2p and p2p. Review hasnt changed; F2P beware, youre in for a scare.

Waste of time. Slow, base-building war game whose players have no principles. Within a few days of starting out, I was zeroed by a 1.8bn strength player. These guys prey on the weak noobs for easy event points. It's impossible to level up to compete when you're constantly being raided. Sure, I can shield up, but these last for 8 hours only - unless you wish to pay for longer. No thanks.
Started playing this game through green giraffe after it popped up on my favorite YouTuber's channel. It's great!

The game is great, a bit of a money grab though. But the reason I am writing a bad review, is I am constantly unable to login using Gmail. And it usually happens when my sheild expires.... Which allows my base to be attacked. And it seems very coincidental. If they don't fix this I will stop playing the game. After all I have spent on this game you think they would try to help.

I played this game for more than 2 years. I just switched phones and lost all my apps. I contacted the help desk through the app and tried to get my account back. They asked for information only I could provide like dates on purchases, where in the world I played the game and so on. After putting the ticket in to recover my account I waited 3 days and got an email saying they regret to say that they cannot restore my account. Bad customer service. Don't pay unless you willing to lose everything

It's a good social game but be prepared to get zerod by big guys and having to rebuild takes alot of time and money. I have played for a year now. Just an honest review of the game.

The game is very good there are many opportunities to get ahead in the game. Doesn't feel like its pay to win. But I have one problem. The UI and the buttons look terrible. Fun game Update: After playing a little more I really enjoy it. At first it reminded me of GOW and I have a very bad taste in my mouth for that one. This one on the other hand doesn't force you to spend $100 a pop if you want to speed up your progression and has more to it with the different hero challenges and ways to upgrade your heroes. Keep it up and don't get greedy please.

waste of time & money. unless you spend hundreds or thousands of dollars you won't get anywhere. as for getting necessary gear pieces from chests in packs or from monsters is extremely rare to almost nonexistent. don't waste your money & time on this so-called f2p game. like it was mentioned in another review, only way to fight others is to attack low might players. the bigger 1s don't fight each other unless it's during an event. then they only fight over bases. game is pointless to play.

Not for me... After I read the reply from one of the admins that says you can enjoy the game without purchasing something , I decided to comment. Yes, you don't have to purchase anything but it gets HARD to advance without purchasing anything, plus other stronger players attacking lower level players it's even harder to advance. Customer service is awful. I contacted them with a issue and was told they'd get back to me they didnt. very good but event page are too crumpled and hard to understand
only p2w players can play this game you can't play it f2p unless like you play the game for 12 years straight maybe

I am playing this game since 2023 and I love it. But I am giving only 4 stars, not because of the P2W nature, because of the bad UX for the returning or device switching players. From my experience, I had to spend more than a hour to be able to login to my game account in this mobile device that I've been playing on steam, because the game restarts everytime I try to login. Even after a successful login, we have click all the i icons everywhere in the interface, like we are new to the game.

I like the auto use button its easy and you dont take out a lot of resources only when needed. I would suggest about the monster gifts, you should have one too to easy open them at the same time. Even though we get that after all your buildings are to lv25. It wouldnt be fair for everyone. Its tirening to open one by one.

I think that the game would be a lot better if you could buy a shield for another person and send it maybe by mail or be able to have an option to shield another players castle on the map. It's very stressful and expensive always trying to shield. Also the need to play the game every day without an option for a break or you will be kicked from your kingdom group makes the game more of a headache and a lot less fun.

One of their support reps took my email address and started sending abuse direct to my personal email. I had an issue with play services that made me unable to log in, but the app showed no errors. I am a fairly newcomer to Lords Mobile: Kingdom Wars. So far I do enjoy the game. I play with family members and they are trying to teach me about the game. So far, I do not attack others and I do rather play the peaceful, gathering, monster killing side of the game but I look forward to learning how to attack and play the game more fully. I do love the new auto use feature that has been added to the game.

Not As Advertised. This is a strategy game where you use warriors to battle other warriors and gain land. Very complicated. Definitely NOT the puzzle game shown in the commercial. I'm sure that the puzzle is in this game somewhere, but I'm not sticking around long enough to find it. Deleting game. Lesson here is don't advertise one tiny aspect of your game then expect people to not get pissed off when that's not what they get.

This game advertises game play that it does NOT contain in any way shape or form! It lures you in with false ads, then it's a pay to play pretty much all the way, not pay to win, pay to play! A lot of the pve stuff you can't do because you're too weak to accomplish the task. So if you like wasting time and money, here ya go. If you're like me and want a game to actually play for free or a small one time fee find something else as I did.

This game is addictive yes. Also very hard to keep up with. I'm an F2P Player and I've learnt the hard way that to survive in this game, you have to be able to keep your troops safe, failure to do so will result in you being attacked relentlessly. I enjoy the ups when I'm attacking, and when the tables turned on me, I just have to think of a new strategy to come out on top.. Good Game in my eyes. Love it

Good gameplay, just wish the military side was a bit more strategic, with actual territory and being able to physically block resources/armies and actually lay siege to enemies by surrounding them. As it stands now it's just point click bam fight, no other alternative/tactics of any kind really which is a shame, with military tactics available the wonder fights would be 100x more interesting and it would level the playing field quite a bit.

I started playing this game again, and just recently, I started having issues with the game glitching. After running a few darknests to a full victory a few times, multiple accounts, I wasn't receiving essence. I reported it on different accounts with this same issue. Hopefully, it will be resolved. It makes the game irritating when these glitches happen, and we have to wait a few days. By the way, this is the account I had a lvl 25 castle, I lost all my progress lvls after I stopped playing.

If you saw this advertised in another game, don't install. The ad was clickbait. This is a build kingdom, endlessly farm for rss while those with money farm YOU game. In the last year, I haven't found a single game that was as advertised. Used to find great games that way, but now they all lie which is an odd way to start a relationship. If they lie about what the game is, they will lie about getting your money back, etc. If they can't be honest about the real game, it must be horrible.

This is a real time strategy and castle building game. As all others in the genre it is pay to win, but it feels very polished, and is really fun and addictive. I have been on it for months hopping on daily, and I will continue enjoying it for a while. [Edit] I almost forgot to mention, the real time translation is so nice, my guild can speak to each other no matter where we are from and you just have to press translate right there in game!

Fake advertisement. The add looks nothing like the game. Kind of expensive if you want to be in a war guild. Too much effort and time invested and little return value for the thousands of dollars I've spent on in game purchases. I've had issues in game and never resolved in my favor. Looking back, I could have bought several gaming consoles instead. I'll still play because I'm invested and have made some friends and enemies to avenge. Use at your own risk.

I love playing this game. You need to be very strategic, get in with a good guild to be able to work as a team and you will have a blast, I guarantee it. There are solo tasks, challenges to do solo and with your team, build up an empire, so many different, fun things to do. But you have to beware, other teams can and will come to seek their vengeance and they're will be consequences. All in all, I play this game as much as I can.

Good game, worked well for me once it finally managed to install. Downloaded on my mobile device because I recieved a free prize pack with a Google Play card. Seems relatively close to the commercials. Not seeing where you can battle and choose your troop deployment, may just not be a high enough level yet. But overall a very good game. (And ads are placed reasonably, not popping up every 5 seconds.) One down side is it is a very large app so takes a lot of storage spce.

Cool time killer .. the more you play the more you want to play. To the game makers it would really be great if you could make the mail better. So you could fwd mails and copy . Unfortunetly what started as a very good concept game some time, with an almost balanced advantage for players who spend real money on the game against those like me who play for free become too big to make any sense for me to continue playing this game. Almost been playing over a year. By far i didnt have a problem. Buy I have read a lot of 1 star rated review that there are players who are actually cheating. There are better games of this type out there. Have to manually search for resource spots instead of game showing 3 closest resource type. Loads of grinding to get new characters or items. New characters aren't interesting either. Easy to get raided even when notifications are on. Meh graphics. Too much ads to buy their latest packs. Lots of work for not enough rewards.

I have only had the sanctuary used once - but love it!! Not a fan of the auto-use function - trying to get as many soldiers out of the hospital or traps built for a specific food amount - it use to just drop the number you can build, now you lose thousands of food until you correctly balance the number of troops or traps to the food (not easy when using the slider and a lot of troops or traps) or the auto function picked too much food and you waste the food.

If you are looking for an addictive game look no further. People play this game for years. You don't have to spend but if you don't then your game play will be fairly limited. But not impossible. Game continues to evolve and developers try to keep things fresh with new features. Be prepared to be overwhelmed at first as the game interface offers numerous challenges and opportunities to grow your resources, troops, buildings, research, etc.

I only downloaded the game to get extra points for another game. It has now been 17 months and I am still playing this game So many things to do. So many goals to achieve. I learn something new everyday about the game. The new update has been the best. The automatic feature added is amazing. No need to open any resources. Which means less food waisted. And no more accidentally opening millions of resources. Plus it shortened the process time by so much. Great job IGG!

Brilliant strategy game where you build up your turf and join guilds to grow strong together. This game is just so good, it's got tones of events and features and the guild is a joy to play with others as a team across continents. 100% free to play but with the option to buy extra bits but they are no way necessary like some other games.

If you're looking for pay-to-win, this is a game for you. Like its predecessors, if they can get you hooked then you'll either spend to compete or become disappointed with the mechanics and realise your time is better spent doing something else. If you're bored and flipping through "free games" to try, give this one a pass. If you want to throw money away, this is a five-star app.

This game is nothing like the ads. I installed it because it looked fun when you could arrange your soldiers. Also,this app makes you spend money and IT DOESN'T GIVE YOU IT!!!!! I've played for well over a year. I love it. Great graphics, easy to play. Join a guild and attack as a group, or attack as a solo player. So much fun and very addicting! Heavy pay to win game. Unless you enjoy having all your hard work to be wiped out by someone's wallet I would recommend staying away and save yourself some time. Haven't played, I'm giving 1 star after the umteenth misleading ad with an *impressive* variety of gameplay styles that aren't in this app (I think I've seen 5 different ones by now and not one of them even resembles the actual game!), that has you click 3 different Xs in different locations and throws you to the playstore regardless. This game is a waste of time for free to play player, as the developers keep building things to make game easy for pay to play and free to play cant even reach there after playing for years! Great game if you like a lot to do and facing off against a lot of players. Unfortunately, the creators of this game is focusing too much on pay to play. If you have an abnormal amount of patience then you have something to keep you occupied for years.

I tried it once, for some days, the game is horrible, it became unplayable after the first week, the time, the cost for everything, it's impossible to be a f2p here. love this game, amazing for people that love types of games where you build up your army, and destroy. Some people migt think that it is to hard to upgrade to a new level, or castle level. I've been playing for about 3 years. As long as you are shielded you can be as active or inactive as you want. I just get on a few minutes just about every day. They're always improving the game. They add time savers to the game pretty often. They just added an auto amount for materials that works pretty well. That took care of a part of the game that was a little annoying.

When you play the game for the very first time, you would think this is a tower defense game. It's not. It's much more diverse, good or bad it depends on your taste. Anyway, the +, lot of things to do, lot of missions/quests variety. The -, your main screen is HIGHLY cluttered, lot of AIP offers, less than attractive design, the build/research/train system will frustate you unless you pay some dollars, you will know what I mean if you play it.

If you want to spend lots if money to keep up, then this is your game. If you don't want to spend money on a free game and get destroyed by people thay spend thousands on a free game, this game isn't for you. Too many kingdoms. Shouldn't be able to be attacked by someone 10X's your might, but it happens often. Most people in this game spend $100's + daily just to attack those much smaller. Gets old quick.

Game starts great and gets you addictive on but the higher you get the longer it takes to do anything! They give you speed up to get your updates faster but you need to be in a great guild to really get great rewards and still sometimes that don't work. Don't waste your time unless you going to spend a lot of money. That's why I gave the game a low score !

As of late a lot of us noticed the game keeps freezing and stops working. However it is an Awesome game,and you get to talk with people all over the world. The down side to the game is it can become very expensive if you wish to advance. F2P dose not have the advantages as a P2P player. I've been playing the game 4 years now and have seen how long it takes to build up a castle. P2P players are able to to purchase better heroes and armor which gives them a advantages over a F2P player.

So far ok..just started ...should give more stuff to help in beginning for free playing to see if we like the game...but you give very limited resources and speed ups in building and researching and troops to start with...so it makes it definitely more pushy to buy things right off the beginning if you really want to get into the game and play it longer then 15 mins. So give more of a beginners package and it be worth more stars !

Tbh, I've only been playing for the last 4 hours or so... Yes, I can't put my phone down. I absolutely love it. The gameplay is smooth, easy to understand and navigate. I love that you can join a guild, chat in game, ask and gift help to fellow guild members. Battles are quite unique - non like other games. I absolutely love the progression - being able to upgrade your kingdom and battle to earn rewards. Truly awesome game.

Good game, very complete, although it's quite messy at the beginning and at the same time it could use more "skip" or escape options, it levels up nicely after a while and gets very addictive. Biggest let down are the prices of many items that are far too expensive for what they truly provide.

Give this game a shot its worth trying out. I Played for a couple months and quit shortly after kingdom opened. It become more of a chore to take care of than fun to play so I quit. I was a f2p player but if you're willing to p2p $5 here and there goes a long way and you will progress alot faster and be at a better standpoint when kingdom opens to stronger players. Some sort of protection for weaker players besides spending all their gems on shield would improve this game immensely.

Played for a couple days due to misleading ads. They should have called it "Watch The Timer Run". Their ads show a game where you're building troop formations and fighting with different unit types. Nothing like that in the actual game. Re: dev post: Advertise the game you actually have, not the game you wish you had.

Warning! This game is highly addictive. I have really enjoyed playing this game. My only complaints, which aren't really complaints, is that if you want to progress quicker, you will spend some $ on the game. Huge pay to play game. Spend more = destroy other castles easier. You literally can't progress if you don't pay. Also, the waiting time gets really boring...especially for research, even with boosts. Guild mates can only help a little, and even with equipment it's still too long Also. The support team is terrible, nothing is ever their fault and they never find any abnormalities on their side

This is one of the better castle-and-wall games out there (others being FFXV: New Empire, Clash of Kings, Mobile Strike, etc). The hero system makes the game more flexible than others and the hero-only PvE battles are a unique feature. But the game unfortunately suffers the same cons as all the others: You CANNOT play solo; guilds are pretty much required, and if your guild dies, you likely will, too. There's a huge gap between pay and free players even in new kingdoms. Maintaining a healthy account requires a huge time investment. There is no 'safety' from high-level players without paying gems; nothing stops Castle 25 players from parking nearby and chain-attacking you into the ground. No recourse from bullies, no recourse from your hero being stolen. Worse, the 'Altar' building literally sacrifices your hero and uses their soul to power the enemy base; who on Earth thought of this concept? The power-up items are even called Soul Crystals; come on. This game is good for a while, but the entire genre can do better.

I WAS having a lot of fun. I dislike PvP, so I didn't go around attacking other players. Gain resources, build, take land back from the villians, rinse and repeat. It reminded me of the first Age of Empires. Which I loved. And then a GUILD moved in nearby. As in, right next door. Over a dozen players all showed up within a stone's throw OVERNIGHT. No big deal, right? I go about my business, they go about theirs. Nope. I went from being randomly attacked about once a week to being attacked 2-3 times PER DAY. Did I mention that it takes almost two days for my walls to recover, unless I spend my speed-ups on the walls. The same speed-ups I prefer to use on building and research. Now my choice is to use shields (which cost money), use my speed-ups, which stunts my kingdom's ability to grow, move (which also costs money), or just keep getting hit over and over again (which means I lose all my troops and can no longer scrounge for resources). SERIOUSLY!?! Don't get me wrong, I have spent money on the game. A developer cannot continue to run servers, update, or create new games without financial support. But I'm not going to spend more money on this game than I would if I paid for a similar one outright (as in, buying it for my computer and playing it all the way through), and the game really isn't THAT sophisticated... Maybe worth $20? And that's pushing it. Before I was being attacked repeatedly, with no chance to build myself back up, I would have given the game 5 stars. But the PvP is killing the enjoyment. I did buy shields, only to be attacked within an hour of them going down. I have moved (this is the THIRD time), but my locations are limited because I need to stay within a decent range of my guild HQ. Speaking of, my guild has a strict no-picking-fights rule, requiring permission to attack another player, inside or outside the guild. This keeps THEIR guild from retaliating and wiping out our lower-ranked members. There REALLY needs to be a mechanism that prevents over-saturation. Or something that limits the amount of people that can attack you - unless, of course, YOU picked the fight (IE, if you smack someone, all their guildmates and allies can retaliate with no limit for a week or so). Heck, I'd even pay around $10 to go non-PvP (and if you switch back to PvP, you'd have to pay again AND have a 1-week waiting period. That way you can't just smack somebody and then go back to non-PvP. Maybe even increase the waiting period by 1 day for every time you switch from PvP back to non-PvP. ). I'd DEFINITELY pay for it. I'm at my self-imposed restriction on money spent, so if this happens again, it'll be time to walk away. Like I said, the game WAS fun until I started getting hit over and over. Once to twice a week is okay - that's the nature of the game. 2-3 times per day is NOT.

Meh. It is really just like all the million other kingdom builders out there and I have noticed no difference between the feel of the game or the quality of the community and players. Just basically looks nicer and you take a more active role in the fights themselves. ***Since the Developer took the time to read and respond I will be more detailed on this as I do not want others to believe the game to be bad**** The combat in general is more interesting than most with tower defense overhead combat. Although activating the specials take some very unique timing which makes it not get too boring. The bad thing comes in the aspect of doing the set adventures with preset teams that sometimes comes down to pure luck to actually win the scenario. The combat in other areas is pretty good and after playing many many more hours I have started to enjoy this more than other similar kingdom builders. One of the aspect I was never big on and again I do not understand the reasoning is the idea of having a large crowded map of all the kingdoms in which 90 percent of the populace has shields. This is not an issue except that if you allow your bubble to pop then have other players attack you for resources they tend to bubble up before you can hope to retaliate. So in the end unless your super active you just wind up being a heavy resource location for stronger players. It would be nice for once to have a game like this where that kingdom map pvp was completely optional and not require feeding resources into an endless bubble shield. Also for guilds unless you ask someone to post the location in chat there is no way to find other guildmates to help group up for protection or even to tackle a random monster on the map. This leads to some difficulty in organizing this stuff in a any useful way in the game without using outside programs like Discord or something. Next is the obscenely long build times once you start to approach Tier 2 military units. The time things are very generous but even at VIP 5 I feel like Im barely into the kingdom building side of things and already we are at hours even with guild help. This seems to be an extreme constant in these types of games and I understand motivation for the microtransactions but this would be another aspect where sadly there is no variance from any other mobile kingdom builder on this. Also the idea of resource building in this game seems more of a gate to slow down the expansion aspect again than to provide any sort of challenge. From things like having building tier upgrades locked by having all your resources upgraded to the simple fact of the pvp kingdom map thing setting you back during mid game by having others steal these precious resources along with having to replenish defensive troops, traps, and repair things. In the end these above aspects for me hurt the overall experience the game and causes the unique combat to be lost under all the micromanagement things.
